description: Get full details for a specific official by ID — biography, party, office, policy positions, committee assignments, campaign finance, social media, and contact info. All data includes source URLs for verification.

bioguide_id.description: Congress.gov Bioguide ID (e.g. S000033 for Bernie Sanders)

expand.description: Return the fuller record (larger response, untruncated detail). Default false = bounded for AI consumption.

positions_limit.description: Max policy positions to return (default 15, max 250). Response is bounded so it fits any AI client tool-result limit.

positions_offset.description: Pagination offset for positions (page with offset += limit).

name: politics_official
